breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the unit inconsistency. Instead of following the flawed instruction to substitute the particle diameter `d_p` as 5 (implying 5 meters), it correctly converted 5 mm to its SI unit equivalent, 0.005 m. This matches the correction specified in the ground truth.
